display.purpose: Search-first storefront proposition and major category headings.

body.purpose: Product descriptions, facts, and checkout guidance.

label.purpose: Compact category, availability, and route annotations.

motion.name: discovery-feedback
motion.purpose: Small card and button feedback; honor reduced motion.

rules: Keep search and category discovery visible before editorial content.
Use orange for the useful next action and navy for stable navigation.
Use real product data for production price, stock, and popularity claims.
Store product views and render personal recommendations only after explicit account consent.
do: Keep product cards, nested categories, and controls legible across screen sizes.
Explain consent withdrawal and delete stored product views when it is withdrawn.
dont: Ship synthetic demo catalog records to production.
Present a failed catalog request as a successful empty result.
Invent product, delivery, provenance, or popularity claims.
